messages.content: An adversary registers a Windows task with schtasks.exe so that a program runs automatically at user logon, to survive reboots. Which MITRE ATT&CK technique does this describe? Give the technique ID.

A threat actor encrypts files across many hosts on a network and leaves a note demanding payment for the decryption key. What ATT&CK technique is this? Provide the technique number.

An actor uses valid administrator credentials to connect over SMB to remote hosts and execute commands, spreading through the domain. Which ATT&CK technique best describes this lateral movement? ID please.
Command-and-control traffic is tunnelled inside ordinary HTTPS requests to blend in with normal web traffic. Name the ATT&CK technique and its ID.
